    14  # Alexandrov-discrete topological spaces
    15  
    16  This file defines Alexandrov-discrete spaces, aka finitely generated spaces.
    17  
    18  A space is Alexandrov-discrete if the (arbitrary) intersection of open sets is open. As such,
    19  the intersection of all neighborhoods of a set is a neighborhood itself. Hence every set has a
    20  minimal neighborhood, which we call the *neighborhoods kernel* of the set.
    21  
    22  ## Main declarations
    23  
    24  * `AlexandrovDiscrete`: Prop-valued typeclass for a topological space to be Alexandrov-discrete

    35  /-- A topological space is **Alexandrov-discrete** or **finitely generated** if the intersection of
    36  a family of open sets is open. -/
